svg.title: TX card cage side and front
svg.text: SIDE (section): back wall and pole left, lid right
8 x PG-7 glands in the bottom wall (2 rows of 4); cables rise in the right zone
TX card cage r2 in the #905 box (hanging, long side up), to scale 3.2 px/mm; box inside 119 x 169 x 69 mm [TBD-MEASURE]
Blue: printed cage. Red slabs: cards. Tan: backplane. Dashed: plug keep-outs. Pack and charger below the cards; the charger outline is a placeholder until measured.
